title: JSON Schema Validation Not Working Correctly
body:
**Bug Description**
When working with json files, it is not honoring the json schema provided to it and cannot seem to adjust to create a valid json file. e.g. https://developer.microsoft.com/json-schemas/copilot/plugin/v2.2/schema.json 

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 0.2.32
- Feedback ID: ca3a1235-d69a-4147-99dd-6e07a86fa4e6
author: jthake
